newsitem.title: USA: Syntellect sees Q2 shr loss $0.19 to $0.22.
newsitem.headline: Syntellect sees Q2 shr loss $0.19 to $0.22.

text.p: Syntellect Inc said Monday it expects a loss per share for the second quarter ended June 30 of $0.19 to $0.22 compared to a loss of $0.03 per share for the same period a year ago.
The company said it expects revenues for the quarter to be in a range of $10.8 to $11.2 million, and a net loss in the range of $2.5 million to $2.9 million.
In the second quarter of 1996, the company posted revenues of $14.0 million and a net loss of $400,000.
The company expects th release complete second quarter results the week of July 21
The company also said it expects to report that revenues from its core system products have increased by about 50 percent in the first half of 1997 over 1996 levels.
